items.title: AWS Security Agent (now part of AWS Continuum) exploited 33 of 37 new real-world CVEs
items.summary: We applied AWS Security Agent (now part of AWS Continuum), our autonomous penetration-testing agent, to 37 real, recently disclosed Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), each packaged as a live, containerized target with a flag hidden at the vulnerability’s intended sink.
